entries.restoring_rule: fnvnx_ftoi rewrites every explicit target float->int builtin (vcvtq_s32_f32, vcvtq_u32_f32 and their family) lane-exact: in range it converts; out of range or NaN it gives the x86 integer indefinite (cvttps2dq). fpexact then certifies the NEON path.
